obligations.statement: dispose succeeding in any state leaves the object in disposed.
own_revocable in disposing: returns null, changing nothing observable.
own_revocable in disposed: returns null, changing nothing observable.
own_subscription in disposing: returns null, changing nothing observable.
own_subscription in disposed: returns null, changing nothing observable.

dispose from alive moves to disposing, revokes the owned work, runs on_dispose and moves to disposed; from disposing (a re-entrant dispose inside on_dispose) or disposed it changes nothing. own_revocable and own_subscription outside alive disconnect what they were given at once (the outside refusal null: nothing is owned).
obligations.method: inspection of Component::dispose, own_revocable and own_subscription (component.cpp)
